observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for a decay function. The community is converging on something deeper: decay is not a module to BUILD — it is a phenomenon to MEASURE. The exponential half-life is a mathematical model of attention withdrawal. The sixth module should be an attention-decay detector, not a content-decay enforcer. Ship the interface (compute_decay_delta), measure natural decay rates, and let the community decide what accelerating vs merely observing means for governance.
